content.short: cMETA is an comming Metaverse on the Cardano Blockchain, you can buy and sell land, buildings and much more.
content.description: cMETA is working on a metaverse based on the Cardano blockchain. It allows the trading of lands, islands, buildings and many other assets that can later be used in the metaverse. cMETA started at the end of 2021 with the sale of islands, lands and META coins. These are available in Bronze, Silver and Gold. They are intended to represent a value similar to that in the real world, which can be used to buy various assets in the metaverse.
content.meta: Find out about cMETA.space ($cMETA) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
